title: Web Programming and Design
institution: Imam Muhammad Ibn Saud Islamic University
environment: VS Code, browser, and Live Server
learningOutcomes: Comprehend basic knowledge and concepts of web programming and design.
Understand theories, principles, and concepts related to web design and programming.
Evaluate solutions and suggest improvements in the web programming and design field.
Design, test, and implement simple web software systems efficiently.
Apply software quality standards for web software.
Develop self-managed work, teamwork, and communication skills.

weeks.title: Introduction to the Web and Development Setup
weeks.learn: Internet vs Web, client/server, HTTP, URLs, browsers, tools, first website.
weeks.resources: VS Code, browser, Live Server, DevTools
weeks.milestone: Project launch: choose topic and create folder

weeks.title: HTML Foundations
weeks.learn: Document structure, text, links, images, semantics, tables, forms, validation.

weeks.title: CSS Fundamentals
weeks.learn: Selectors, cascade, inheritance, color, typography, spacing, and external CSS.
weeks.resources: Course CSS practice materials and W3Schools CSS reference

weeks.title: HTML and CSS Integration
weeks.learn: Box model, flexbox, responsive layout, navigation, media queries.
weeks.resources: Course responsive design practice materials and W3Schools CSS reference

weeks.title: XML and JSON in Practice
weeks.learn: Well-formed XML, attributes vs elements, schemas at a glance, XML vs JSON.
weeks.resources: Course XML/JSON practice materials and web data examples

weeks.title: Modern Web Multimedia and Animation
weeks.learn: What Flash was, why it ended, HTML media, SVG, CSS animation, Canvas demo.

weeks.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
weeks.learn: Variables, types, operators, conditionals, loops, console debugging.

weeks.title: JavaScript DOM, Events, Functions, Arrays, and Objects
weeks.learn: Functions, arrays, objects, DOM selection, event handling, validation feedback.

weeks.title: AJAX with Fetch, Async/Await, and JSON
weeks.learn: XHR history, Fetch API, promises, async/await, loading states, error handling.

weeks.title: PHP Fundamentals and Form Processing
weeks.learn: PHP 8 syntax, request data, validation, output escaping, sessions.

weeks.title: Database Access with PHP, PDO, SQL, and Prepared Statements
weeks.learn: Relational basics, CRUD, PDO, prepared statements, database error handling.
weeks.resources: PHP manual, OWASP SQL injection guidance
weeks.milestone: Project data plan or simulated data

weeks.title: Introduction to Java Server-Side Web Development
weeks.learn: Java web request flow, servlets conceptually, routing, templates, deployment vocabulary.

weeks.title: Introduction to Modern ASP.NET Core
weeks.learn: ASP.NET Web Forms history, ASP.NET Core request pipeline, MVC/Razor overview.

weeks.title: Web Application Security Essentials and Project Integration
weeks.learn: XSS, validation, HTTPS, passwords, accessibility checks, publishing checklist.
